QuestInfo.name: An Unresolved Question
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p425# at #m10003007# looks somehow relieved.
QuestInfo.1: #p425# at #m10003007# seemed genuinely glad, deep down, that the powerful evil spirit had turned out to be #b#o700006##k, and not #p412#. Still, why had #o700006# come to hold such deep resentment, and just what had happened in that marshland connected to Niora Hospital? Finding the answers to all of this doesn't seem like it'll be easy. It's about time I headed back to #b#p900014##k at #b#m10003010##k.  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: #p900014# at #m10003010# seemed relieved to hear that the powerful evil spirit, #o700006#, had been defeated, but there was still something about it that seemed to be bothering him. Still, it doesn't seem like there's anything more to find out for now.

0.0: So the powerful evil spirit really wasn't #p412# after all. Is it strange that I feel relieved about that? Though, I suppose somewhere along the way, I'd started thinking of that girl's ghost as one of this city's own residents too.
0.1: Thank you, truly, for going to such lengths to help that girl's ghost. Letting #p900014# know about her existence might have been the right call for #p412#'s sake, but... I find myself wanting to keep an eye on that ghost a little longer, all the same. Well, I suppose it's about time to go tell #p900014# about the powerful evil spirit now.

yes.0: Oh, but I do wonder — what was #o700006#, in the end? And that marshland at the end of the hidden passage in Niora Hospital, just what was that all about...? Why can't I shake this uneasy feeling...?

no.0: I have to say, I'm a little thrown that you're turning me down now, of all times.

1.0: That took you long enough. What could you possibly have been doing with #p425# for this long? What...? You're saying you found a marshland deep inside a hidden passage in Niora Hospital, and there you found and defeated a powerful evil spirit named #o700006#...?
1.1: If you'd found an evil spirit, you should've come back to me — taking it down yourself, huh, you've got some nerve. But remember this: an evil spirit isn't something you simply cut down. Its grudge needs to be laid to rest. That's exactly why exorcists like me exist in the first place.
1.2: Hmph... well, either way, doesn't sound like there'll be any trouble for a while now. Hm...? You think that spirit might be connected to Niora Hospital somehow? Hmph... I suppose that's not unreasonable, but there's no evidence to back it up right now. Best to just forget about this for the time being. I'll be on my way, then.

npc.0: So in the end, the powerful evil spirit threatening #m10003000# wasn't #p412# after all, but something called #o700006#..
